🚨 𝗫𝗥𝗣 𝗕𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗞𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗡𝗘𝗪𝗦 | Nov 15, 07:04 AM ET

Seven spot XRP ETFs smashed records on day one, raking in a jaw-dropping $58 million in trading volume on November 13, 2025—making XRPC the hottest ETF launch of 2025, narrowly beating out $BSOL’s $57 million. Yet, in classic crypto fashion, XRP took an 8% nosedive immediately after, sparking a wild “sell-the-news” reaction despite fresh whale moves and an end to Ripple’s legal saga with the SEC. The markets overall are battered, but the XRP Army’s power was undeniable, flooding social channels and pumping volume like never before.

How did this chaos unfold? Ripple’s triumph over the SEC removed a massive legal cloud, unleashing institutional appetite for XRP ETFs. Canary Capital’s Steven McClurg confirmed XRPC’s record first-day volume amid a brutal market backdrop, proving the community’s muscle and Ripple’s expanding real-world enterprise use cases are legit catalysts. The coordinated whale activity and ETF inflows created volatile trading swings, but the underlying demand for XRP is crystal clear.

What’s next? These ETFs unlock long-term liquidity and institutional access previously unseen for XRP, setting the stage for sustained ecosystem growth. Legal clarity supercharges Ripple’s global partnerships and innovation engines on the XRPL, fueling adoption beyond speculation. Buckle up—XRP is gearing for a new era as a mainstream powerhouse, ready to ride out short-term dips and dominate 2026. The XRP Army’s fight is far from over; it’s just heating up.

data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Naglabas ng abiso ang Department of Transportation (DOTr) ukol sa pansamantalang traffic interruption sa northbound lane ng East Avenue sa Diliman, Quezon City, bukas, Linggo, Nov. 16.

Bahagi ito ng isang oras na solidarity walk mula 7 a.m. hanggang 8 a.m. bilang paggunita sa National Day of Remembrance for Road Crash Victims and Their Families.

“Motorists are advised to expect heavy traffic, use alternative routes, and allow additional travel time. Traffic personnel and marshals will be on site to manage vehicle flow and ensure public safety,” saad ng DOTr.

📷:  Department of Transportation/Facebook
